title: hierochloe redolens var. gunckelii
intro: Hierochloe redolens var. gunckelii, commonly known as sweet grass, is a perennial grass native to North America, known for its sweet, vanilla-like fragrance and traditional uses in herbal medicine. The health benefits of sweet grass include its potential to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and alleviate stress. The therapeutic actions of sweet grass include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic agent, making it useful for treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of sweet grass include essential oils, including vanillin, geraniol, and beta-caryophyllene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
